item.title: Help Our Neighbors in Kankakee and Iroquois!
item.description: Our neighbors in Kankakee are facing a long road to recovery after this week's devastating tornadoes. If you're looking for the fastest way to help families who've lost everything, join us in supporting the United Way of Kankakee and Iroquois Counties. Your donations go directly to the Emergency Response Fund for local shelter and rebuilding.
